successCriteria.description: The `calculateRequestedDays` function is removed from `src/modules/validation/validation.service.ts` and no longer exported from `src/modules/validation/index.ts`.

`validateLeaveRequest` derives the requested day count by calling `requestedDays(dto.startDate, dto.endDate)` directly (the canonical helper imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts`), producing identical results to the removed wrapper.
The validation service test file no longer imports `calculateRequestedDays` and its wrapper-specific test block is removed; the remaining `validateLeaveRequest` tests still pass.
A full repository search finds no remaining code references to `calculateRequestedDays` (only optional descriptive documentation mentions may remain).

constraints: The canonical `requestedDays` helper in `src/shared/types/index.ts` is the single source of truth for the inclusive day-count rule and must not be modified or re-derived; this phase only removes the delegate and points the call site at the canonical helper.

The public behavior of `validateLeaveRequest` (input validation, date-range validation, sufficiency check, and the exact day-count result) must remain unchanged — this is a pure refactor with no behavioral change.
The `requestedDays` import already present in `validation.service.ts` must be retained and used; no new derivation logic may be introduced in the validation module.
outOfScope: Modifying the canonical `requestedDays` helper or its existing tests in `tests/unit/shared/types.test.ts`.
Updating documentation references (`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `PLAN.md`) that describe the delegate — these are informational and optional.
Changing the behavior, signature, or error semantics of `validateLeaveRequest`, `validateDateRange`, or `validateSufficiency`.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The day-count derivation used by `validateLeaveRequest` must match the canonical `requestedDays` implementation (inclusive `endDate - startDate + 1`, whole-day only, no weekend/holiday exclusion) — call it directly rather than re-deriving.

The validation module's public surface must remain consistent with the documented `IValidationService` contract (validateDateRange, validateSufficiency, validateLeaveRequest) — only the standalone `calculateRequestedDays` export is removed.
